For β>1/√2, Nβ≤√2 β E with equality only on diagonal rays; same chain forces vertices and two diagonal chords, giving coordinate-swapped orbit. At β=1/√2 axes and diagonals together yield union. Finite check only after justified vertex reduction; degenerate endpoints excluded.
